sourceTitle: The Eulogies of Howard: A Vision
description: "The Eulogies of Howard: A Vision" by William Hayley is a philosophical and poetic work written in the late 18th century. This reflective piece serves as a tribute to John Howard, a pioneering philanthropist known for his extensive humanitarian work, particularly in prisons and for the treatment of the sick.
